name: MARKEL GROUP INC.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-26), Consolidated Statements of Changes in Equity: 'Equity awards expensed' $54,982 thousand in 2025, $53,302 thousand in 2024 and $35,787 thousand in 2023 ($ in thousands in that statement). The Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows in the same 10-K lists no share-based compensation addback line, and EDGAR companyfacts carries no ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense fact for 2023-2025.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc - SBC missing for fiscal years 2023, 2024, 2025 of the last 3 under the engine's tags. The filer's own reported FY2025 equity awards expensed from its 10-K equity statement fills the gap; the engine applies this single value to every missing period. The true per-year series in the same statement is $35.787M (FY2023) / $53.302M (FY2024) / $54.982M (FY2025), so applying $54.982M to all three years overstates SBC in the two earlier years and makes the base slightly conservative; SBC at this level is about 2% of OCF and immaterial to the verdict.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 2.3%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-26), Consolidated Statements of Changes in Equity: 'Equity awards expensed' $54,982 thousand in 2025, $53,302 thousand in 2024 and $35,787 thousand in 2023 ($ in thousands in that statement). The Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows in the same 10-K lists no share-based compensation addback line, and EDGAR companyfacts carries no ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense fact for 2023-2025.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
